title.en: MALACANANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES PROVIDING FOR THE SURRENDER AND LICENSING OF LOOSE FIREARMS AND THE UTILIZATION OF FUNDS FROM THE PROCEEDS THEREOF

text.en:
Any natural and juridical person who possess loose firearms
may surrender the same to the Philippine National Police for custody and apply
for the corresponding license as required by existine laws within one (1) ear
from the effectivity of this Order, excluding the election period (January 14, 2007
to June 13, 2007), which was declared by the COMELEC pursuant to COMELEC
Resolution 7707. Concerned holders of said firearms may avail of this amnesty
only within the period. Each firearm submitted for licensing shall have Its own
distinct firearm description.

As a general rule, high-powered rifles/paltik firearms may
not be allowed for licensing. However, the Chief, PNP may allow the licensing of
some high-powered firearms. Those who will surrender the same will not be
prosecuted for illegal possession of firearm while in the act of surrendering the
said firearms.

An amnesty fee of Three Thousand Pesos (3,000.00) for
High Powered Firearms and Two Thousand Pesos (P2,000.00) for Low Powered
Firearms, shall be collected for each firearm registered,

Fees coliected in Section 3, thereof, shall be treated as a
Trust Liability and deposited in a Special Account in an Authorized Government
Depository Bank (AGDB) to support the nation-wide implementation of the
Firearms Information Management System (FIMS),
Firearms Records
Manadement System and the Firearms Ballistic Information System in the priority
and, any unexpended balance therefrom, shall be reverted to the General Fund.

The Firearms and Explosives Division (FED), Civil Security
Group (CSG), the Regional Offices and the Provincial/City Police Offices of the
PIP involved in the processing and registration of loose firearms shall retain
20% of the gross proceeds of the collection to support their respective direct
costs of licensing operation.

The Chief, PNP shall issue such implementing Rules and
Regulations (IRR) that will effectively carryout the provisions of the Executive
Order subject to the approval/concurrence of the Secretary of the Interior and
Local Government.
All orders, issuances, rules and regulations or parts thereof
inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.
PONA. Heathan : 37837

This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 11th day of
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Six.
Deember in the
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
